fact: The World Bank project appraisal document for the Digital Zambia Acceleration Project provides US$50 million IDA grant plus about US$18 million UCF for an Affordable Broadband component, to add at least 2,000 km of fibre, possibly supplemented by the national Universal Access and Service Fund.
title: Project Appraisal Document on a Proposed Grant to the Republic of Zambia for a Digital Zambia Acceleration Project (DZAP)
